metadata.description: A per-repo code-graph plugin for Claude Code. Committed SQLite code maps with full-text search and cross-codebase parity linking.

plugins.name: codebase-kg
plugins.description: Builds, maintains, and serves a per-repo code graph — a committed SQLite map of any codebase (nodes = components with symbol anchors, edges = relationships) so an agent can orient and find code without re-deriving the map every session. Opening the graph is constant-time at any size and search is a persisted FTS5 index, so it stays fast on a monorepo; dangling edges, duplicate ids and inconsistent data are impossible to write rather than merely reported afterwards. Language-agnostic: node `kind` is free-form, source reading is agent-driven, all per-repo specifics live in config. Cross-codebase parity: a node links directly to its counterpart in another repo's graph, carrying a parity status + one-line divergence, so 'find all feature gaps' is a query across both graphs. Ships the schema, skills (query/build/refresh/audit/link/validate), thirteen MCP tools (seven queries and six validated writes) plus CLI-only stats, validation and parity-gap queries, a search gate that makes an agent consult the graph before it greps, and commit/push staleness checks (the push check blocks only on stale mapped files). A code mirror, descriptive not prescriptive, source-derived not ticket-derived.
